summary: VEEA Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $4,353,000 of common stock through Roth Capital Partners. The filing includes notice of a board-approved 1-for-20 reverse stock split to regain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance. This is a routine shelf takedown and capital raise, not a special situation. The reverse split is a governance action related to listing standards, not a restructuring or other special category. Watch for completion of the reverse split and potential dilution from ATM sales.
